system: civil law system based on the Prussian model; influenced by Japanese traditions and Communist legal theory

constitution.amend: proposed by the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA); passage requires more than two-thirds majority vote of the total SPA membership

courts.highest: Supreme Court or Central Court (consists of one judge and 2 "People's Assessors" or, for some cases, 3 judges)
courts.judges: judges elected by the Supreme People's Assembly for 5-year terms
courts.lower: lower provincial courts as determined by the Supreme People's Assembly

citizenship.descent: at least one parent must be a citizen of North Korea

suffrage: 17 years of age; universal and compulsory
world: has not submitted an ICJ jurisdiction declaration; non-party state to the ICCt
